data_needed: Binance USD-M and COIN-M perpetual futures limit order book depth snapshots (10 bands, 30-second grid)
Binance 1-minute futures closes and 300-second forward transaction-price returns
Aug 2025 - Jul 2026, 8 underlyings, ~13M labeled examples
method: Shadow Before Swap: warm-refit a challenger model off the serving path each week and promote it over the maintained incumbent only when it wins a paired NLL margin on the same delayed labels.
reason: Inputs are 40 order-book depth features per 30-second snapshot on Binance perpetual futures; Coinbase OHLCV cannot recreate the LOB panel or the 300-second tick-level labels.

data_needed: Shenzhen Stock Exchange Level-1 quote and trade data
Intraday order-slicing simulator with market impact
LLM inference (GPT-class models)
method: PACE, a hierarchical LLM agent that splits parent-order execution into long-horizon volume planning and short-horizon child-order placement, benchmarked against TWAP and Almgren-Chriss.
reason: Requires Chinese exchange Level-1 microstructure data and an execution simulator; nothing in the free stack supports intraday execution cost measured in basis points.

data_needed: None - closed-form and exact lattice computation only
method: Finite-horizon binary multiplicative process with a lower absorbing boundary and residual value; exact lattice propagation gives the growth-optimal fixed exposure versus log distance to the boundary, horizon, and residual ratio.
reason: Pure theory - all six figures come from lattice simulation with no market data, so there is no empirical result to check parity against.

data_needed: Motley Fool and MarketWatch news article corpus, Feb 2015 - Jun 2021 (~355k articles)
Yahoo Finance daily prices for S&P 500 (available to us)
Llama-3-8B-Instruct with LoRA + GRPO reinforcement training on a GPU
method: FinSMART post-trains a financial LLM with GRPO using realized next-day open-to-open returns as the reward, then forms a daily long-short S&P 500 portfolio from the sentiment scores.

data_needed: On-chain wallet-level DeFi transaction traces (124,638 transactions, 1,073 labeled malicious wallets)
Protocol-level volume and sector mappings for a specific ecosystem
Proprietary live incentive-campaign allocation results
method: Composite percentile-normalized activity score with two-layer protocol/sector weighting, plus a four-layer sybil defense stack (integrity checks, autoencoder + isolation forest ensemble, behavioral memory, graph clustering).
reason: Entirely blockchain wallet-graph and internal campaign data; Coinbase OHLCV gives no on-chain transactions and the sybil labels are proprietary.

data_needed: Private point-in-time web corpus with a dense retrieval sandbox and cutoff-date access control
FinanceGym: 400 expert-validated research questions with rubrics
Frontier LLM inference plus an LLM judge for rubric scoring

reason: Results are LLM rubric pass rates (25.3% to 32.4%), not market returns; needs a private PIT web corpus and expert-annotated rubrics, no price data involved.

data_needed: German hourly day-ahead power prices, 2023-2024
German hourly wind and solar generation profiles
EEX power futures curves and monthly PPA strikes for 2025
method: Model-free decomposition of a pay-as-produced PPA strike into baseload forward, deterministic profile adjustment, and price-volume covariance term, with a Levy-driven bivariate MCARMA state-space model calibrated to German data for the semi-static hedge.
reason: European hourly power prices, renewable generation, and power futures are outside the free stack entirely - FRED has no German intraday power or generation series.

reason: Pure mathematical finance with no empirical section; and any real version would need option chain bid-ask quotes, which we do not have.

data_needed: None - theoretical SPDE analysis, no calibration data
method: Shows the Ito-Wentzell random-PDE reduction of the conditional density SPDE holds under local stochastic rough volatility, giving a pathwise Fokker-Planck equation with an explicit lognormal conditional density for rough Heston.
reason: No empirical content at all; the implied application (Rao-Blackwellized calibration) would need option surfaces we cannot get.
